items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [inaudible] and Jimmy Smith had recorded Bluesette.

ctx.x: And for a period of time, were you going back to Europe frequently?

Yes. I did [inaudible] there. But I had one lucky break. I was composing, you know, of course, and I had written Bluesette, which was never a major hit. But a hit goes like that, and Bluesette is the kind of song as… [inaudible] and Jimmy Smith had recorded Bluesette. And once 100,000 copies, albums. That’s 100,000 pennies then, you know. For me, as a composer. You split with the…
